notes: v1.0.15 — Engineering pass: (1) RENDER-FRAME CRASH FIXED: the NPE 'Camera.getCameraEntityPartialTicks: this.level is null' was a lifecycle race during world unload/disconnect — a new CameraMixin null-guards the exact dereference site, so Launcher→menu→world→unload→menu survives in every state with or without Dynamic FPS. (2) Multiple instances now supported: each profile gets its own independent game process, status, logs and Stop button (Play on other profiles no longer turns into Stop). (3) Sodium compatibility: LevelRenderer chunk-pool override is skipped when Sodium is present; a Sodium Detection toggle was added. (4) FPS Boost 1.0.3: new in-game PerfProfiler (frame time, render time, tick time, chunk build time, GC count) shown on the overlay and parsed by the launcher. (5) Legacy Fabric: MC <1.14 now resolves the Legacy Fabric API instead of an incompatible modern build (fixes 1.13.2 Fabric API errors). (6) Dependency resolver confirms installed deps before prompting. FPS Boost is version-gated to 26.2.x to avoid injecting a 26.2-specific implementation elsewhere.
